title: The v1 'extraordinary precision' slogan is not sourced here
summary: The older article's claim of verification 'to extraordinary precision' and similar superlatives was not tied to a measurement.
body: The v1 relativity article said both theories have been verified with extraordinary precision and grouped GPS, accelerators, and astronomy as confirmation. Specific tests are on other cards (1919 deflection, Hafele-Keating, Ashby on GPS, LIGO). The superlative itself, and any implied error bar that was not quoted from a paper, is not given a source here. A retrieval system should prefer the named experiments over the slogan.

legacy.note: v1 truthScore and source-count fields are not evidence and are not copied.
